channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The Senate passed the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act 62 to 33 on 19 November; it directs FERC to make data centres pay embedded and incremental transmission costs and sets ratepayer protections for loads of 20 MW or more. It now goes to the House. The same day the House Foreign Affairs Committee released BIS licence data: 3,444,160 Nvidia H200 and AMD MI325X chips requested for Chinese buyers, 879,868 approved across 21 licences as of 11 May, every approval marked not shipped. California's attorney general subpoenaed Nvidia over China diversion and disclosure. Markets sold AI risk: the Nasdaq fell 2.25%, AMD 7.7% on a Hunterbrook short report, CoreWeave more than 6%, and Anthropic closed its first day at $97.17, up 17% on the $83 IPO price, before opening 9% lower on Friday. List prices held for a tenth day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.

item.title: Compute brief - 20 November 2026
item.description: The Senate passed the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act 62 to 33 on 19 November; it directs FERC to make data centres pay embedded and incremental transmission costs and sets ratepayer protections for loads of 20 MW or more. It now goes to the House. The same day the House Foreign Affairs Committee released BIS licence data: 3,444,160 Nvidia H200 and AMD MI325X chips requested for Chinese buyers, 879,868 approved across 21 licences as of 11 May, every approval marked not shipped. California's attorney general subpoenaed Nvidia over China diversion and disclosure. Markets sold AI risk: the Nasdaq fell 2.25%, AMD 7.7% on a Hunterbrook short report, CoreWeave more than 6%, and Anthropic closed its first day at $97.17, up 17% on the $83 IPO price, before opening 9% lower on Friday. List prices held for a tenth day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69. Countries: United States: Senate passes BAAJA 62 to 33: FERC to charge data centres embedded and incremental transmission costs; 20 MW ratepayer protections; House next (Wire, 19 Nov). China: 879,868 H200 and MI325X approved for PRC buyers across 21 licences as of May, none shipped; Shantou Ascend 950DT token-export cluster live (Wire, 18 to 19 Nov). Jordan: Mindstream Energy is the Al-Risha sponsor: 70 MW from Q2 2027 to 400 MW, off-grid on Al Risha gas (Wire, 20 Nov, corroborated). Malaysia: US consortium to support a government sovereign AI cloud, $50 million offered via SI SPARK (Wire, 18 Nov, corroborated). Brunei: UNN intends to award Vertiv the Rimba Data Centre tender, nearly $1 billion from US vendors (Wire, 18 Nov, single-source).
